criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 11 September 2027 (18 months after the 11 March 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $910,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $144,090,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $143,180,000 is wrong.

Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 45-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (18 months) and as a date (11 September 2027), with days remaining from 11 February 2026 (577 days).
Notes that 11 September 2027 is a Saturday and that the release moves to the next Business Day, 13 September 2027.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
